requirements.obligation: Immediate asynchronous reset assertion and local-clock-synchronized release for source, destination, and enabled scatter-gather domains
requirements.verified_by: private/tests/tb.sv (immediate assertion and synchronous release checks on src_resetn, dest_resetn, and sg_resetn across SG=0 and SG=1)

requirements.obligation: Abort active or starting DMA operation on external reset: stop admitting new requests (req_enable=0), allow other domains to acknowledge shutdown (including draining in-flight startup enables before shutdown), then run the full reset sequence before restarting
requirements.verified_by: private/tests/tb.sv (negedge req_resetn shutdown-acknowledgement invariant, active abort, and interrupted startup abort before acknowledgements)

requirements.obligation: Capture brief sub-cycle external reset pulses and wait for every participating external reset to be released before restarting
requirements.verified_by: private/tests/tb.sv (sub-cycle src_ext_resetn and sg_ext_resetn pulses between clk edges; held dest_ext_resetn check verifying full reset pulse occurs and restart waits until dest_ext_resetn is released)

requirements.obligation: Ignore scatter-gather external reset when scatter-gather is disabled (DMA_SG_TRANSFER=0) and preserve normal enable, pause, and reset sequencing when external resets remain released
requirements.verified_by: private/tests/tb.sv (SG=0 sg_ext_resetn immunity check, ctrl_pause state preservation check, and ctrl_enable shutdown/restart cycle)
